data.name: Summoning: Underworld Gate
data.description: A giant gateway through which beings can cross over. Only needs to be trained once.
data.battleDescription: %user pricks their finger on one of their weapons to draw blood. Using that blood they summon a giant gateway.

data.name: Possessing Yurei
data.description: Summoning up a Yurei from the underworld to possess the target
data.battleDescription: %target finds they've lost most control over their body as they are dominated by this otherworldly creature.

data.name: Oni Hammer Swing
data.description: Opening a portal to the underworld, a large hand juts out to attack
data.battleDescription: %user summons a large portal from which a giant hand shoots out slamming down on %target

data.name: Otherworldly Conduit
data.description: Your body is a lightning rod for otherworldly chakra. You've learned to harness it to empower yourself.
data.battleDescription: %user channels the power of the underworld into their own body drastically improving their abilities.

data.name: Herald of the Black Night
data.description: A technique that covers the battlefield in a shadowy portal to the world of yokai.
data.battleDescription: %user clasps their hands in a praying motion as a shadowy mist flows from beneath them covering the entire battlefield.

data.name: Aqua Dragon Barrage
data.description: A relentless barrage of water dragons that crash into the target with crushing force.
data.battleDescription: %user conjures a series of water dragons that surge forward in rapid succession, each one slamming into %target with overwhelming pressure. The combined force of the barrage floods their defenses and strikes from multiple angles, delivering devastating aquatic impact.

data.name: Mizukumi
data.description: A water-based jutsu that strikes hard and absorbs some of the damage dealt to restore the user.
data.battleDescription: %user moves like liquid vengeance—fluid, controlled, and deadly. As they strike %target, water chakra clings to their limbs like a second skin, lashing out with every movement. Upon impact, Mizukumi siphons the force of the blow, pulling a portion of the enemy’s vitality into the user’s own body. The water ripples with life, wrapping around %user like a veil of stolen strength. Each strike doesn’t just punish—it replenishes.

data.name: Hollow Veil
data.description: A silent chakra barrier that protects the user and weakens the foe
data.battleDescription: %user weaves a single seal, cloaking %target body in a thin, shimmering veil of chakra. This veil absorbs all impact and saps the strength of %target

data.name: Phantom Requiem
data.description: A sinister technique that saps the life force of enemies, draining their chakra and stamina with every passing second.
data.battleDescription: %user forms a seal, summoning a ghostly mist that seeps into %target’s body. Wisps of blue and red energy—chakra and stamina—are ripped from them, spiraling into %user’s grasp. %target’s limbs grow heavy, their strength fading as exhaustion takes hold. If they don’t break free, they’ll collapse under the relentless drain.

data.name: Chakra Overflow
data.description: A potent chakra buff that enhances all offensive abilities and raises the user’s stats.
data.battleDescription: %user channels a surge of chakra beyond their natural limit, their aura expanding in a volatile ripple of power. This overflowing chakra wraps around them in waves—thick, radiant, and barely restrained. Chakra Overflow heightens every offensive path: physical strikes land harder, ninjutsu hits with greater force, and even genjutsu becomes more potent. Simultaneously, the user’s core stats spike, fueling their body and mind for the intensity of high-stakes combat. It’s the edge between control and chaos—a moment where the user becomes a living conduit of power.

data.name: Subaku Palace
data.description: Stolen from the Subaku Castle, This forbidden Jutsu grants the users the powers to call forth the demon palace to increase their offense and defense
data.battleDescription: %user presses their hand to the ground, a chakra formula spreads from their hands to the corners of the battlefield, large demon gates appears out of the earth surrounding %target

data.name: Kinjutsu: Black Thorn Rose
data.description: Once learned, this jutsu marks the user with a tiny rose bud that grows with each use, feeding off the user’s life force. Once the jutsu is activated, it plants a rose on the target that siphons their energy away.
data.battleDescription: Chakra vines grow out from %user and latch on to %target  suppressing their ability to heal and regenerate.

data.name: Demon Maiden’s Howl
data.battleDescription: %user gathers their chakra in their throat letting loose a loud screech to ward off death from her allies

data.name: Life Siphon
data.description: Drains the lifeforce of the target to empower yourself

data.name: Summoning: Pestilence
data.description: The first patron of the parade.
data.battleDescription: From the gate steps a large fish-like creature with a bird-like head. It let loose a loud shriek as it prepares for battle.

jutsu.name: Unbearable Hunger
jutsu.battleDescription: A spectral boney hand grasps %target around the neck causing their body to begin to dehydrate and almost mummify.

item.description: An ethereal claw attack from another dimension
item.battleDescription: Creatures from the underworld seem to pop into existence briefly and claw at %target
